# IJITEST Full Semantic Context

## About the Journal
The **International Journal of Innovative Trends in Engineering, Science and Technology (IJITEST)** is a premier international, peer-reviewed, open-access journal. It serves as a global platform for researchers, academicians, and professionals to publish breakthrough research and innovative trends across various disciplines.

## Aim and Scope
IJITEST covers a broad spectrum of multidisciplinary areas, including:
- **Engineering**: CSE, ECE, EEE, Mechanical, Civil, Chemical, etc.
- **Science & Technology**: AI, Machine Learning, Data Science, Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics.
- **Healthcare & Life Sciences**: Medical research, Nursing, Healthcare management.
- **Management Sciences**: HR, Finance, Marketing, Operations.

## Editorial Process
- **Peer Review**: Double-blind peer review process.
- **Timeline**: 4-6 weeks for initial decision.
- **Plagiarism Policy**: Zero tolerance; checked via industry-standard tools (Crossref/iThenticate).
- **Ethics**: Follows COPE (Committee on Publication Ethics) guidelines.

## Author Information
- **Submission**: Online through the Author Portal or email.
- **Template**: Standard Microsoft Word template required.
- **Article Processing Charge (APC)**: Covers SJIF impact evaluation, long-term hosting, and indexing maintenance.

## Institutional Credentials
- **Publisher**: Felix Academic Publications
- **Location**: Andhra Pradesh, India
- **UDYAM Registration**: UDYAM-AP-10-0125617

## Verification & Citation
To verify paper authenticity, use the 'Track Manuscript' feature on the website with the unique Paper ID.
Official website: [https://www.ijitest.org](https://www.ijitest.org)
